title: catalpa × erubescens var. japonica
intro: Catalpa × erubescens var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese Catalpa or Red-Leaf Catalpa, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese Catalpa are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
